subject: Marginal variance equation and kappa in SPDE approach

messages.author: 4427b64dfcb5da5b
messages.subject: Marginal variance equation and kappa in SPDE approach
parts:
Hi,

I have a question regarding the SPDEtoy example that users can arbitrarily select a value for the marginal variance and kappa and simulate a dataset and then try to recover the underlying true model parameters based on the observations.
 
However, based on the
Lindgren (2011) https://doi.org/10.1111/j.1467-9868.2011.00777.x marginal variance equation. That equation connects the marginal variance and the kappa value with the nu and dimension (d=2). Thus, if d and nu are fixed, the marginal variance is closely related to the kappa, and what I understand is that if the kappa is selected, the marginal variance should be automatically chosen based on this equation. Then, why does the SPDEtoy simulation example select two arbitrarily values for kappa and the marginal variance, respectively, and the estimated kappa and marginal variance do not strictly fit that equation?

Best,
B
